mapper.insert: insert into learning_agent_step (task_id, user_id, seq, step_type, tool_name, args_json, observation_json, status, error_code, elapsed_ms, create_time) values (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{seq}, #{stepType}, #{toolName}, #{argsJson}, #{observationJson}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{elapsedMs}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select step_id, task_id, user_id, seq, step_type, tool_name, args_json, observation_json, status, error_code, elapsed_ms, create_time from learning_agent_step where task_id = #{taskId} order by seq asc, step_id asc
